next.reason: 1985: 'After the execution of the WRITE statement is complete, the information in the area referenced by identifier-1 is available'; 2023: 'After the successful execution of a WRITE statement, ... provided that identifier-1 is not one or part of one of the record descriptions'. 2023 makes identifier-1 available only after successful execution, and only if it is not part of the file's record descriptions. 1985 covers any completed WRITE, without that proviso.
